prerequisite: C2 exact-head Pre-Unreal + UE4.27.2 core/production-import green and merged to develop.
purpose: Assign only stable foliage material identities to M_ProductionFoliage while preserving all gameplay/world ownership, asset IDs, albedo bindings and density.

parent_assignment_contract.c3_scope: C3 assigns the near/mid foliage parent only. Far/no-WPO LOD material-slot binding belongs to C4 after actual mesh LOD/cull review.
parent_assignment_contract.identity_rule: Use exact normalized material identity from authored MTL/material instance names. Do not infer foliage from arbitrary texture color or mesh filename substrings.
preservation: Keep deterministic material instance object paths unchanged.
Do not rename gameplay discovery IDs, quest IDs, save keys or world ownership.
Do not increase foliage instance density.

implementation_shape: Centralize foliage-name classification in an editor-import helper/predicate.
When creating or refreshing a deterministic material instance, choose ProductionFoliageParent only for the approved foliage identities.
All other material identities remain on ProductionSurfaceParent.
Do not synchronously load heavy gameplay assets; editor commandlet material lookups remain editor-only.
Keep importer idempotent: rerunning must not duplicate material instances or change object paths.
guards: Validator requires the exact approved foliage identity set.
Validator rejects broad contains('Leaf') or contains('Grass') heuristics that could capture unrelated materials.
Validator requires no density/ownership/gameplay-ID changes in C3.
Validator requires M_ProductionFoliageFar to remain unused until C4 mesh/LOD binding.
acceptance: Production import succeeds and material instances retain deterministic object paths.
PIE visual wind acceptance remains later manual evidence, not implied by import success.
evidence_boundary: C3 is machine-green and merged. This proves static/compile/import/headless exercised behavior only; no PIE/device/visual/performance acceptance is implied.

contract: Trim authored material name and match only exact case-sensitive identities Grass, Leaves, LeafGreen, LeafGold.
Approved identities use M_ProductionFoliage as the material-instance parent.
All other identities remain on M_ProductionSurface.
Material instance object paths, albedo bindings, Color/Roughness/Metallic values and foliage density are preserved.
